description: Translate a CPIC-supported diplotype or allele-status result for one gene. Supply geneSymbol and exact diplotype notation, including star alleles, named HLA positive/negative statuses, or non-star sequences; use pgx_search_alleles and pgx_list_reference with topic phenotypes to inspect supported values. Exact lookup precedes bounded reverse-order or status aliases. Multiple source rows remain ambiguous; no activity score or missing gene result is inferred.

diplotype.description: Exact source diplotype or allele-specific status, such as *1/*2 or *15:02 positive.

geneSymbol.description: Gene symbol, such as CYP2C19 or HLA-B; outer whitespace is ignored.

name: pgx_lookup_diplotype

diplotype.description: Trimmed supplied notation; source responses are unchanged.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_selector`: A required selector is blank after normalization. `query_too_broad`: An internal bounded scan or attempt budget is exceeded. `upstream_query_rejected`: CPIC rejects the generated query. `upstream_rate_limited`: CPIC rate limits requests. `upstream_unavailable`: The source is unavailable or returns maintenance HTML. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Whether at least one source row matched.

guidance.description: Recovery guidance for missing or ambiguous source rows.

matchedDiplotype.description: Notation matched in the source, or null.

notices.description: Notices about this result; empty when none apply.

provenance.description: Live source attribution and retrieval details.

accessedAt.description: UTC access timestamp for live requests.

apiVersion.description: API interface version, not a database release.

requestUrls.description: Exact requests made during this workflow.

items.description: Version of one retrieved source record.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the returned version-bearing record.

requestIndex.description: Index in requestUrls of the source request.

records.description: Every matching source row; multiple rows are ambiguous.

items.description: Source diplotype result and lookup keys.

activityvalue1.description: Source activity assignment for allele slot 1.

activityvalue2.description: Source activity assignment for allele slot 2.

diplotype.description: Exact source diplotype or allele-status notation.

anyOf.description: Source gene symbols mapped to allele names and copy counts.

diplotypekey.description: Original source allele-count key, null, or omitted.

ehrpriority.description: Source EHR Priority Result; not an inferred risk score.

generesult.description: Gene phenotype or allele-status result according to the gene lookup method.

anyOf.description: Source gene symbols mapped to exact source strings.

lookupkey.description: Normalized source gene result key for recommendation or test-alert lookup.

totalactivityscore.description: Source total diplotype activity-score string; never inferred from missing slots.
